description: Run database migration against live Supabase, commit all changes, and push to main
steps: Run the Supabase migration: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && export SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN=*** && cd /projects/sandbox/ashram-shala-pathraj-portal && supabase db push
Run final lint check: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && npm run lint
Run final build: source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && npm run build
Git add all changed files, commit with message 'feat: content safety agent, activity monitor, WhatsApp notifications, full admin panel', and push to main
acceptance_criteria: Migration runs successfully against live Supabase
All changes committed and pushed to main
verification: git log --oneline -1 shows the correct commit message
